resources.string: This is an unavailable build scaffold, not a completed feature.
Radio setup, pairing and permissions have not been ported. This scaffold does not request permissions or connect a radio.
Messaging is not available in this scaffold. No messages are loaded or sent.
Node discovery and contacts have not been ported. No contacts or connected nodes are simulated.
Remote node management is unavailable. No login or device-changing command is performed.
Maps are unavailable. No map engine, tile provider or location service is loaded.
Radio tools are unavailable. No CLI command, trace or scan is performed.
Preferences and backup restore have not been ported. Translation is unavailable; no engine is linked.
